metadata.description: Focused multi-CLI plugins for backend architecture, SwiftUI, ESP32 firmware, API and UI validation, and runtime seam probing

plugins.name: backend-architecture
plugins.description: Small, opinionated architecture guide for production backend services across languages and frameworks

plugins.name: swiftui
plugins.description: Lightweight, opinionated SwiftUI guidance with detailed Apple-platform references loaded only when relevant

plugins.name: esp32-cpp
plugins.description: Evidence-first ESP32 firmware guidance for hardware, FreeRTOS, memory, peripherals, and field failures

plugins.name: backend-validator
plugins.description: Backend API and WebSocket validation via Hurl, websocat, and oauth2c with OIDC token caching

plugins.name: maestro-mobile-validator
plugins.description: iOS and Android mobile app validation via Maestro flows with simulator management and CI patterns

plugins.name: electron-playwright-validator
plugins.description: Electron app UI automation and validation via Playwright CDP

plugins.name: peekaboo-macos-validator
plugins.description: Runtime observation, interaction, and visual critique for native macOS interfaces via Peekaboo

plugins.name: seam-probe
plugins.description: Generic NDJSON probe for embedded-runtime FFI dylibs and Unix-domain sockets
